description: Stationnements spécifiques - Mons is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Mons. Ce jeu de données regroupe les places de stationnement ayant une utilisation spécifique (PMR, achats-minutes, voitures partagées et électrique). ← Retour au catalogue complet. Coverage: Mons. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Stationnement, Mobilité, PMR, Cambio, Voiture partagée, Riverain. The portal shows 747 records. The portal shows 2026-01-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
